rule: Undoing only the operations below, in order, must give the exact r1 bytes (tools/static_audit_r2.py). r1 itself is chained to v1 and v1 to the NORMAL480 originals by their own static audits (42 and 81 checks), which the r2 audit runs again.
scope_kept: Java, entry, parent, CONTRACT, physics, request list, coordinates, baseline CSV bindings, limits, native budgets, paths and identifiers are unchanged (byte-identical to r1). Only the consumer's transient DOF line grammar and its policy string change.

reverse.reason: BMIN-R1-N1: inside mesh_evidence, the single DOF line found in the single Time-Dependent Solver section must match the DOF statement as a whole line (re.fullmatch with surrounding whitespace allowed) instead of re.search (first partial match). Two statements on one line, or a valid statement followed by an incomplete one or by any other trailing text, now give TRANSIENT_DOF_READBACK_FORMAT (I-3 incomplete) instead of taking the first value. The line count, the section markers, solved > 0, the outside-section record and the record-only policy for a valid different value are unchanged. The dof_policy string states the same rule.

CODE_MANIFEST.json.changed: previous_manifest_sha256 = r1 manifest; size / SHA-256 of the consumer

COMMAND_MAP.json.changed: manifest SHA only (manifest_sha256 and the last argv of parent / execute / analyze)

known_limits: Unchanged from r1: the entry returns rc 1 when its preservation / policy / cleanup checks fail after a native run, so such a run stays native_completion NOT_ESTABLISHED (cause NATIVE_CHILD_RC) - accepted by the re-review as a conservative limit; it is not a confirmed solver failure and the original error stays in NATIVE_STATE.json.

Unchanged from r1: GNativeAxis consumes the consumer's structured termination output as a separate parent condition; it is not an independent measurement of the raw native logs (that comparison stays in native_stop).

New in r2: the whole-line grammar assumes the batch log writes the DOF statement as the whole line (surrounding whitespace allowed), as quoted by the re-review for NORMAL480 batch.log line 131. A prefix such as a timestamp would make a valid run I-3 incomplete (a false negative, on the fail-closed side); we do not hold the raw log, so the re-review request asks for that line to be checked.
c1_wording: PS01-03 / PS01-04 check the limit-adjacent values and label consistency only; they are not decimal-precision rounding tests. PS01-16 is a string with 30 decimal places (28 significant digits) just above the limit whose expected result is INCOMPLETE through the consumer / parent disagreement - the fail-closed principle, not a precision guarantee, and not an exact-equality case. (r1 wrote '31 significant digits' here and in the plan; corrected in r2.)
